mapper.sql: select id, order_no, submit_key, pickup_token, pickup_display, pickup_date, user_id, shop_id, order_type, scheduled_pickup_time, order_status, pay_status, refund_status, product_amount, pack_fee, total_amount, remark, pay_time, accept_time, make_start_time, complete_make_time, verify_time, cancel_time, cancel_reason, estimated_ready_time, create_time, update_time from biz_order

select o.id as order_id, o.order_no, o.user_id, u.phone as user_phone, o.shop_id, coalesce(s.name, '历史门店') as shop_name, s.phone as shop_phone, o.order_type, o.scheduled_pickup_time, o.order_status, o.pay_status, o.refund_status, o.product_amount, o.pack_fee, o.total_amount, o.remark, o.pickup_display, o.pickup_date, (select coalesce(sum(oi.quantity), 0) from biz_order_item oi where oi.order_id = o.id) as item_count, o.estimated_ready_time, o.pay_time, o.accept_time, o.make_start_time, o.complete_make_time, o.verify_time, o.cancel_time, o.cancel_reason, o.create_time from biz_order o left join shop s on s.id = o.shop_id left join c_user u on u.id = o.user_id
mapper.insert: insert into biz_order(order_no, submit_key, user_id, shop_id, order_type, scheduled_pickup_time, order_status, pay_status, refund_status, product_amount, pack_fee, total_amount, remark, create_time) values(#{orderNo}, #{submitKey}, #{userId}, #{shopId}, #{orderType}, #{scheduledPickupTime}, 0, 0, 0, #{productAmount}, #{packFee}, #{totalAmount}, #{remark}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: where id = #{id}
where id = #{id} for update
where user_id = #{userId} and submit_key = #{submitKey}
where user_id = #{userId} and submit_key = #{submitKey} for update
where order_no = #{orderNo}
select count(1) from biz_order where user_id = #{userId} and order_status = 0 and pay_status = 0
order by id desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}
select count(1) from biz_order

select count(1) from biz_order o inner join biz_order cur on cur.id = #{orderId} where o.shop_id = cur.shop_id and o.pay_status = 1 and o.order_status in (1, 2) and o.id <> cur.id and ( case when o.order_type = 'PREORDER' and o.scheduled_pickup_time is not null then o.scheduled_pickup_time else o.create_time end < case when cur.order_type = 'PREORDER' and cur.scheduled_pickup_time is not null then cur.scheduled_pickup_time else cur.create_time end or ( case when o.order_type = 'PREORDER' and o.scheduled_pickup_time is not null then o.scheduled_pickup_time else o.create_time end = case when cur.order_type = 'PREORDER' and cur.scheduled_pickup_time is not null then cur.scheduled_pickup_time else cur.create_time end and o.id < cur.id ) )

select coalesce(sum(i.quantity), 0) from biz_order o inner join biz_order cur on cur.id = #{orderId} inner join biz_order_item i on i.order_id = o.id where o.shop_id = cur.shop_id and o.pay_status = 1 and o.order_status in (1, 2) and o.id <> cur.id and ( case when o.order_type = 'PREORDER' and o.scheduled_pickup_time is not null then o.scheduled_pickup_time else o.create_time end < case when cur.order_type = 'PREORDER' and cur.scheduled_pickup_time is not null then cur.scheduled_pickup_time else cur.create_time end or ( case when o.order_type = 'PREORDER' and o.scheduled_pickup_time is not null then o.scheduled_pickup_time else o.create_time end = case when cur.order_type = 'PREORDER' and cur.scheduled_pickup_time is not null then cur.scheduled_pickup_time else cur.create_time end and o.id < cur.id ) )
mapper.update: update biz_order set order_status = #{orderStatus}, pay_status = #{payStatus}, refund_status = #{refundStatus}, pay_time = #{payTime}, accept_time = #{acceptTime}, pickup_token = #{pickupToken}, pickup_display = #{pickupDisplay}, pickup_date = #{pickupDate} where id = #{id} and order_status = 0 and pay_status = 0
mapper.select: where shop_id = #{shopId} and pay_status = 1 and order_status in (1, 2, 3) order by case when order_type = 'PREORDER' and scheduled_pickup_time is not null then scheduled_pickup_time else create_time end asc, id asc limit #{limit}
where order_status = 0 and pay_status = 0 and create_time < #{deadline} and id > #{minId} order by id asc limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into pickup_sequence(shop_id, pickup_date, current_seq) values(#{shopId}, #{pickupDate}, 1) on duplicate key update current_seq = current_seq + 1
mapper.select: select current_seq from pickup_sequence where shop_id = #{shopId} and pickup_date = #{pickupDate}
order by o.id desc
where o.id = #{orderId}
select count(1) from biz_order where shop_id = #{shopId} and pay_status = 1 and order_status = 2

where shop_id = #{shopId} and pay_status = 1 and order_status = 1 and ( order_type = 'NORMAL' or (order_type = 'PREORDER' and scheduled_pickup_time is not null and scheduled_pickup_time <= date_add(now(), interval #{makeLeadMinutes} minute)) ) order by case when order_type = 'PREORDER' and scheduled_pickup_time is not null then scheduled_pickup_time else create_time end asc, id asc limit 1 for update
select coalesce(sum(quantity), 0) from biz_order_item where order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.update: update biz_order set estimated_ready_time = #{estimatedReadyTime}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select distinct shop_id from biz_order where pay_status = 1 and order_status = 1
